function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

**Ji Sung Park (Park Ji‑sung)** – commonly known simply as **Ji Sung** – is a South Korean actor who has become one of the most respected performers in Korean television and film.

| Year | Notable Work | Role |
|------|--------------|------|
| 2001 | *The King of Pigs* (TV series) | Debut role |
| 2005 | *The Good Wife* (TV series) | Supporting role |
| 2012 | *The King of Pigs* (film) | Lead role |
| 2016 | *The Good Wife* (TV series) | Lead role |
| 2018 | *The Great Seer* (TV series) | Lead role |
| 2020 | *The King of Pigs* (TV series) | Lead role |

### Quick Facts
- **Birthdate:** March 20, 1979  
- **Birthplace:** Seoul, South Korea  
- **Education:** Seoul National University (Department of Theater and Film)  
- **Years Active:** 2001–present  
- **Agency:** C-JeS Entertainment (as of 2023)  

### Career Highlights
- Ji Sung first appeared on screen in the 2001 drama *The King of Pigs*, but it was his 2012 film adaptation of the same title that brought him widespread acclaim.  
- He has earned multiple awards for his performances, including the Grand Prize (Daesang) at the 2018 KBS Drama Awards for *The Great Seer*.  
- Known for his versatility, Ji Sung has portrayed everything from a troubled youth in *The King of Pigs* to a charismatic historical figure in *The Great Seer*.  
- He is also recognized for his strong work ethic and dedication to his craft, often spending months preparing for roles.

### Personal Life
- Ji Sung married actress Kim Hye‑so (not to be confused with the actress Kim Hye‑soo) in 2019.  
- The couple has a daughter, born in 2021.  

### Other Notable Projects
- **Film:** *The King of Pigs* (2012), *The Great Seer* (2018)  
- **Television:** *The Good Wife* (2016), *The King of Pigs* (2020)  
- **Web Series:** *The King of Pigs* (2020) – a 12‑episode web drama that gained international attention.

---

If you were referring to a different Ji Sung Park (for example, a musician, academic, or public figure in another field), please let me know and I can provide more specific information.
